verdict.rationale: dltHub docs say users can schedule, refresh, and backfill runs through a decorator-based Python API. Core dlt documents incremental loading, merge/upsert by key, and full-load replace semantics. Together these imply history backfills and reloads without rebuilding the pipeline, but the backfill and refresh claims are thin marketing-level mentions tied to the managed dltHub layer. Nothing shows a single table being resynced independently. Missing for 10: explicit per-table/per-resource resync or refresh documentation, detail on how backfills work (date ranges, state reset), independent or hands-on corroboration.
